title: Search result FAQs
description: Top search results show the most relevant posts for your search query. They're personalized based on your >x< activity and the people you follow.

: Top posts are selected through an algorithm, we do not manually curate search results.

q: Why don't I see the posts I like in top posts?

runs: Top posts are the most relevant posts for your search. We determine relevance based on the popularity of a post (e.g., when a lot of people are interacting with or sharing via reposts and replies), the keywords it contains, and many other factors. If posts you love aren't showing up as top posts, it means they may not be the most relevant results for your search. You can tap
to see the most recently-posted posts matching your query.

q: How can I make these top results go away, or come back?

runs: You can change the type of search results you see by clicking or tapping the filters at the top of your search results.
